# Unit test for function cycpattern_check
def test_cycpattern_check():
    # Basic true cases
    assert cycpattern_check("abcd", "abd") == False
    assert cycpattern_check("hello", "ell") == True
    assert cycpattern_check("whassup", "psus") == False
    assert cycpattern_check("abab", "baa") == True
    assert cycpattern_check("efef", "eeff") == False
    assert cycpattern_check("himenss", "simen") == True

    # Rotation cases
    assert cycpattern_check("abcabc", "bcab") == True   # rotation "bcab" is substring
    assert cycpattern_check("abcabc", "cab") == True    # rotation "cab" is substring
    assert cycpattern_check("abcabc", "acb") == False   # "acb" is not a rotation of "abc"

    # Empty pattern
    assert cycpattern_check("abc", "") == True

    # Pattern longer than string
    assert cycpattern_check("ab", "abc") == False

    # Identical strings
    assert cycpattern_check("abc", "abc") == True

    # Single characters
    assert cycpattern_check("a", "a") == True
    assert cycpattern_check("a", "b") == False

    # Repeated characters
    assert cycpattern_check("aaaa", "aa") == True
    assert cycpattern_check("aaa", "aaaa") == False

    print("All test cases passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_cycpattern_check()
